activity.overview: Listen to a poem and find the words that rhyme.
activity.passage:
Who Sat Where?
The cat sat on a big red mat.
The dog sat on a log.
The bee sat in a tall green tree.
And I sat with my frog!

questions.prompt: Say a new word that rhymes with dog.
Which words in the poem tell you what color things are?
